blocks.text: Screengrab Senate of the Philippines / YouTube MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Raffy Tulfo on Wednesday grilled the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), which is under the Department of Labor and Employment (Dole), over regional directors who have remained in their posts for years, with some allegedly staying for decades. During the Senate finance committee’s 2027 DOLE budget hearing, Tulfo questioned why the PRC does not regularly reshuffle its regional directors, saying prolonged tenure in one post could lead to familiarity and possible collusion with review centers. “Sa lahat ng mga government agencies, nagkakaroon ng reshuffle.
